description: This file defines the FrontMatter class used for parsing front matter from source files, including extracting YAML front matter and content, and providing methods to access parsed data and content.

classes.name: FrontMatter
classes.description: A class for parsing and extracting front matter (YAML) and content from source strings, providing access to data, content, and line number.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the FrontMatter object with source string and serializer class.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new FrontMatter instance.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the source to extract front matter data and content, caching the result.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the content part of the source after front matter.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns the parsed front matter data as an array.

methods.name: getLine
methods.description: Returns the line number where the content starts.
